FOR SALE BY PRIVATE TREATY
7, REDFORD PARK VIEW, LUCAN, CO. DUBLIN. K78 R9TO.

To organize a viewing or to place a bid on this property go to www.teamlorraine.ie or scan the QR code on the photograph section of this brochure.

`Welcome to a home that will take your breath away!`.

Team Lorraine Mulligan, national and international award-winning agents with over 25 years` experience, are very proud to present this spectacular BER A2 rated four-bedroom end of terrace home. Designed with real flair, beauty and luxury. This very special and very beautiful residence has been finished to an exceptional standard, it has the look and feel of a five-star show home, with every upgrade already in place. Simply move in, unpack and enjoy and without the high cost, lengthy delays and disruption of bringing in builders. 

From the moment you step inside, the quality is unmistakable. `Herringbone` floors flow from the bright hallway into a magnificent dual aspect kitchen, dining and living space. The sage green kitchen, with its elegant island and warm LED lighting, is the true heart of the home and a wonderful setting for family life and entertaining. A stylish guest WC and a beautifully fitted utility room complete the ground floor.

On the first floor, the sitting room is a showpiece, with a fluted timber feature wall, a wood effect media wall and a glass fronted bio-ethanol fireplace. The main bedroom has built-in wardrobes and a luxurious ensuite with a rainfall walk-in shower, and the home office with bespoke fitted storage makes working from home a pleasure. Two further bedrooms and an elegant family bathroom are on the second floor.

The professionally designed southwest facing rear garden is a real highlight, catching the sun from midday until evening. A glass roofed garden room with sliding glass panels, LED lighting and wood effect cladding opens from the kitchen, creating a year-round space for relaxing and entertaining. To the rear, an aluminium pergola with an adjustable louvred roof shelters a raised hot tub area. A low maintenance artificial lawn, raised stone clad planters with LED lighting, lollipop and feature willow trees, and landscape lighting complete this private outdoor retreat. This is a magnificent and very luxurious outdoor space.

Everything On Your Doorstep

The location speaks for itself. Local schools and sports clubs cater well to GAA and athletics. For day-to-day living, The Crossings with Tesco, Aldi, SuperValu, and Lidl are all close by, along with a good range of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants, and the Finnstown Castle Hotel for special occasions nearby. A newly built community centre hosts regular family events throughout the year.

Effortlessly Connected

Commuting is easy from here. The train station is within walking distance, putting Heuston Station roughly 12 minutes away, while Lucan Village is a pleasant 20-minute walk. Dublin Bus routes C and L run every 10 15 minutes, bringing you into Dublin city centre in around 30 minutes. The N4 and M50 are within easy reach, and Dublin Airport is approximately 25 minutes` drive.

A home where no expense has been spared ready for its next family to move in and simply truly fall in love with their magnificent new home.

INTEREST IS SURE TO BE STRONG.
